text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Pant! Pant! Pant! Pant... Phew.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's tomorrow. Tomorrow is finally the
day...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Oh, Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Are you well? The time has finally
come—the
Arima Kinen is tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec, that's right! I can't believe you're entering too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I mean, the Arima Kinen's long distance. Don't tell me your goal's to win across four distances?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Actually, it is.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A long-distance contest makes for a
crazed wind
indeed. But I believe the
best approach is to face
it head-on.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Because within the maelstrom rages an
azure
storm, one that means to make a
miracle happen.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If I were to shy away from that storm, I'd
end up
the definition of a dry pampero.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, you wanna race against
me?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I do.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Got it, got it... Heh heh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez. So now I've got even more
pain-in-the-butt
rivals to deal with!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Oh, and also...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: This is for you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ooh!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! You got me some honeyade!
Awesome!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hi, everyone! Sorry for the wait!

text_block_list.name: Teio Fans
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoooaaa! She's actually here! Tokai
Teio's
actually here!

text_block_list.name: Teio Fans
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teiooo! We've missed you so
much!

text_block_list.name: Teio Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Just listen to those cheers! Tokai Teio is back! The undefeated Double Crown champion has returned!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
After suffering multiple injuries and
overcoming
an arduous recovery period,
Tokai Teio is
officially back in the
paddock for today's Arima
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to racing with you
today,
Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Zephyr... Yeah. Right back at you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're tough. So is everyone else here.
And I
might not be able to run as well as
I did before
my injuries...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But none of that changes a thing! I'm
gonna win
this anyway!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm Tokai Teio—the undefeated
Monarch
who's gonna perform a miracle
and surpass the
Emperor!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...An azure storm, more fierce than ever
before.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I must answer it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I will become the wind. And after
breathing in
even your miracle, I will
transform into a great
gale.
